## How it was made

Standard v1 ([docs/PIPELINE.md](../../../docs/PIPELINE.md)): measured to scale, re-rendered straight
and clean from a photo, every printed label checked.
Body aspect 0.413 (spec 0.4229), screen at the exact 240:320 aspect.

**Credits:** appearance from a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/200906_t715_frontopen_galaxysilver/200906_t715_frontopen_galaxysilver-4074f541.webp (newmobile.com press set, reflection cropped off)); geometry measured on a [photo](https://cdn.nieuwemobiel.nl/media/200906_t715_frontopen_galaxysilver/200906_t715_frontopen_galaxysilver-4074f541.webp); specs: [teltarif.de](https://www.teltarif.de/h/sony-ericsson/t715/).
